nodes.npc: Hello, welcome! Did you book a room with us?
nodes.npcZh: 你好，歡迎！你有在我們這裡訂房嗎？

replies.en: Yes, I did. My name is Taylor Chen.
No, I didn't. Do you have a room for tonight?
Yes, I have book a room.

reaction.en: Oh, you booked a room? OK, what's your name?
reaction.zh: 喔，你有訂房？好，請問你的名字？

replies.explain: 「有訂房」是已經發生的事，要用過去式 booked（或現在完成式 I have booked），不能說 have book。

nodes.npc: Thanks, Taylor. I see it here. One room for two nights, right?
nodes.npcZh: 謝謝，Taylor。我查到了，一間房住兩晚，對嗎？

nodes.npc: Let me check… Yes, we have one room left. It's one hundred dollars a night.
nodes.npcZh: 我查一下……還有一間空房，一晚一百元。

replies.en: Great. I'll take it for one night.

nodes.npc: Would you like one big bed or two small beds?
nodes.npcZh: 你想要一張大床，還是兩張小床？

replies.en: Two beds, please. I'm here with my sister.
replies.zh: 兩張床，我和妹妹一起來。

nodes.npc: OK. Your room is 201, on the second floor.
nodes.npcZh: 好的，你的房間是 201，在二樓。

replies.en: Thank you. What time is breakfast?

nodes.npc: OK. Your room is 305, on the third floor. It's a big room!
nodes.npcZh: 好的，你的房間是 305，在三樓，房間很大喔！

nodes.npc: Breakfast is from seven to ten in the dining room.
nodes.npcZh: 早餐七點到十點，在餐廳供應。

replies.en: Great. And what time do I need to check out?

reaction.en: Sorry? Oh, are you asking about check-out time?
reaction.zh: 抱歉？喔，你是在問退房時間嗎？

replies.correction: What time do I need to check out?
replies.explain: 問句要用助動詞倒裝：What time do I need to...?，不能照中文語序說 What time I must...。

nodes.npc: Check-out is at eleven. Here's your key. Enjoy your stay!
nodes.npcZh: 十一點退房。這是你的鑰匙，祝你住得愉快！

replies.en: Thank you so much. Good night!
